items.title: AI Architect
items.text:
ai architect data & analytics

 

your mission

as an ai architect you will define scalable and resilient ai agent architectures while establishing reusable patterns, components, and frameworks to support consistent and efficient development.

 

what you’ll do

  • design and implement scalable, fault-tolerant agentic architectures.
  • develop and maintain traceability, monitoring, and evaluation mechanisms for ai systems.
  • implement guardrails and security measures to ensure safe and compliant ai usage.
  • build and optimize retrieval-augmented generation (rag) pipelines and vector search frameworks.
  • collaborate with stakeholders to define requirements and communicate technical concepts effectively.
